sheets.prompt: Create one production 2D painted dark fantasy COMBAT SPRITE STRIP, exactly THREE figures in one horizontal row, three equally sized cells, no extra figures or portraits. Use the FIRST reference as the precise POSE guide: preserve the three different silhouettes in exactly their left-to-right order. The SECOND reference supplies armor identity and painted material style ONLY. Base Reaver: blackened steel plate with subdued brass edging and a ragged burgundy-red cape. SAME character, body proportions, helmet, plate details, sword length and cape across all three frames. One two-handed greatsword, two hands on the grip. All characters face SCREEN RIGHT toward the opponent. Pose 1: LOW ADVANCING RUSH: deeply bent leading right knee, rear left leg stretched backward, chest leaning far forward, both hands hold greatsword LOW BESIDE AND BEHIND hips, blade tip trails diagonally DOWN LEFT toward rear boot; cape streams far behind to left. No forward thrust. Pose 2: OVERHEAD WINDUP: broad planted stance, leading knee bent right, torso lifted, BOTH hands above helmet, greatsword raised overhead and angled BACK DOWN LEFT behind shoulder, like the middle reference figure. Cape flows left. Pose 3: HEAVY DOWNWARD CLEAVE: crouched deep into leading right knee, torso leaning forward, both hands low in front, sword slams diagonally DOWN RIGHT at the ground; small bright pale-gold curved impact slash at sword tip on the RIGHT. Match reference silhouette closely, not a thrust or standing swing. Use the same side three-quarter camera and consistent nominal standing height across three drawings; do not scale crouched figure to fill its cell. Full boots, sword tips and cape ends inside each cell with 10 percent margins, no overlap. Keep the armor painterly, detailed, faceted material highlights, charcoal shadows and restrained metallic gleam. Genuine transparent background if supported, no checkerboard, no floor shadow, no labels or text. Three separate readable keyframes, not a collage.
